credit: Traced from S01, plan of the Yuanmingyuan, image courtesy of the Princeton University Art Museum; check points read on Esri World Imagery (coordinates only), research/georef/check_points.json

properties.name: Placement accuracy: Yuan Ming Yuan, west
properties.note: Yuan Ming Yuan west of the nine islands: the plain of 山高水长, 安佑宫, the west wall. The plan is schematic here (Q8) and many ponds were dug or filled after 1950. Figures: distance between where the fit puts a check point read on the plan and where it is today, metres.

properties.name: Placement accuracy: Yuan Ming Yuan, east and the nine islands
properties.note: Yuan Ming Yuan from the nine islands round 后湖 to 福海's west shore scenes: 前湖, the 正大光明 axis, 舍卫城. Figures: distance between where the fit puts a check point read on the plan and where it is today, metres.

properties.name: Placement accuracy: 福海 Fuhai and its shores
properties.note: 福海 and its shore scenes, up to the wall with Changchun Yuan. Figures: distance between where the fit puts a check point read on the plan and where it is today, metres.

properties.name: Placement accuracy: Changchun Yuan
properties.note: Changchun Yuan without the Xiyang Lou strip: its lakes, 含经堂, the south and east walls. Figures: distance between where the fit puts a check point read on the plan and where it is today, metres.

properties.name: Placement accuracy: The Xiyang Lou strip
properties.note: The Xiyang Lou strip on Changchun Yuan's north edge; ruins read on today's imagery. Figures: distance between where the fit puts a check point read on the plan and where it is today, metres.

properties.name: Placement accuracy: Qichun Yuan
properties.note: Qichun Yuan; its lakes were re-dug in modern times. Figures: distance between where the fit puts a check point read on the plan and where it is today, metres.

properties.name: Check point K-CC-01
properties.feature: bridge over the mouth of the channel leaving the SW corner of the 海岳开襟 lake southwards (between the west strip and the 思永斋 island), bridge centre
properties.note: A blind check point: never in a fit. Error = fit minus today's position.

properties.name: Check point K-CC-02
properties.feature: north lake below 泽兰堂/宝相寺: its NW corner, apex where the north shore turns south along the root of the long strip from 海岳开襟
properties.note: A blind check point: never in a fit. Error = fit minus today's position.

properties.name: Check point K-CC-03
properties.feature: 海岳开襟 lake, NW corner: SW tip of the peninsula between the lake and the channel running north towards the Xiyang Lou strip (west of 法慧寺)
properties.note: A blind check point: never in a fit. Error = fit minus today's position.

properties.name: Check point K-CC-04
properties.feature: south mouth of the narrow channel east of the 思永斋 island, where it opens into the south lake; centre of the mouth (on the plan the centre of the bridge across it)
properties.note: A blind check point: never in a fit. Error = fit minus today's position.

properties.name: Check point K-CC-05
properties.feature: SE corner of the north lake (NE of 含经堂): south end of the narrow N-S channel (about 4-5 m wide) that ends just north of a small pavilion
properties.note: A blind check point: never in a fit. Error = fit minus today's position.

properties.name: Check point K-CC-06
properties.feature: south end of the channel west of the 思永斋 island (north of 茜园): SW end of the diagonal causeway that crosses the water SW-NE, where it leaves the west bank
properties.note: A blind check point: never in a fit. Error = fit minus today's position.

properties.name: Check point K-CC-07

properties.note: A blind check point: never in a fit. Error = fit minus today's position.

properties.name: Check point K-CC-08
